title: l10n_th WHT PND Form Generation L3 Deep
gap_finding: PND3 and PND53 exist only as aggregate financial report records; no per-vendor WHT certificate model, no PND form wizard, no statutory QWeb layout. PND-1 is entirely absent. WHT taxes use invoice-time mechanism with no payment-time deduction. l10n_account_withholding_tax exists but is not linked to Thai templates.
key_finding: Thai WHT PND form generation does not reach L3 in community: PND3/PND53 are 4-line aggregate reports, PND-1 is absent, no per-vendor certificate model exists, and the payment-time withholding module is disconnected from Thai tax templates.
